title: Writing Task 1 - Pie Chart: Household Spending
description: IELTS Writing Task 1: Describe two pie charts showing household spending in two countries.

stimuli.title: Task 1: Household Spending — UK vs Japan
stimuli.content:
You should spend about 20 minutes on this task.

The two pie charts below show the proportion of household income spent on different categories in the UK and Japan in 2019.

Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

Write at least 150 words.

Data: UK — Housing 31%, Food 18%, Transport 14%, Healthcare 8%, Education 7%, Entertainment 12%, Other 10%. Japan — Housing 26%, Food 24%, Transport 11%, Healthcare 12%, Education 10%, Entertainment 9%, Other 8%.

questionGroups.instruction: Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

questions.content: Describe the two pie charts showing household spending proportions in the UK and Japan.

keyFeatures: Housing was the largest expenditure in both countries, though higher in the UK (31% vs 26%)
Japanese households spent considerably more on food (24% vs 18%)
Healthcare spending was notably higher in Japan (12% vs 8%)
UK residents allocated more to entertainment (12% vs 9%)
